exposure: LATCH score at 24h, 48h, and at discharge
finding: A LATCH score of <6 at 48 hours was a significant indicator for intervention to promote exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: The median LATCH score at 48 hours differed significantly between vaginal deliveries (7) and those delivered by LSCS (6.5), P < .0001
birth_weight: Infant weight was recorded at 6 weeks
